entities.summary: Brigadier-General Louis-Marie-Joseph Maximilian Caffarelli du Falga was a French Army officer and scholar. His younger brothers Marie-François Auguste de Caffarelli du Falga (1766–1849) and Louis-Marie Joseph Caffarelli (1760–1845) were also generals.
